This small plot is my fruit trees — I think they are coffee and some enset near the house, since that is what we grow here in Oromia. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer on this plot, so I will put a little urea around the trees when the rains come, but mostly I rely on manure from my cattle and the household waste. The trees are old ones from my father, so I do not buy new seed. I will weed and prune myself with my wife's help, and maybe call my brother for a few days when it is time to harvest.
